approval_source: Author decision in this conversation: E0作者科学协议裁决
augmentation: paired horizontal flip p=0.5; bilinear RGB, nearest labels; RGB/255

mask_aware.foreground_reduction: sum of foreground logits; not probabilities and not logsumexp

ohem_empty_selection: Preserve historical NaN; stop and record without loss fallback or automatic restart
data_governance_scope: Scheme approved for P3 preparation only; real P3 execution not authorized

development_split.eligible_pool: original train minus complete train-connected quarantine groups
development_split.grouping: exact decoded RGB D4 identity plus reliable supplied parent evidence
development_split.unknown_or_conflicting_parent: Report and BLOCK; no invented parent IDs or independence claim
development_split.official_test_usage: source identity and exclusion only; no tuning, validation, threshold derivation or checkpoint selection

nonfinite_or_protocol_or_resource_except: stop, retain evidence; no automatic configuration change
incomplete_rule: Any run not completing 10000 successful optimizer updates is INCOMPLETE; only a complete fixed endpoint is comparable

metric_contract.overall_miou: pixel confusion aggregate, includes background across IDs 0..3
metric_contract.foreground_miou: mean pixel aggregate IoU over IDs 1..3
metric_contract.case_metrics: equal-weight cases reported separately; both empty is null; one empty is zero
metric_contract.boundary_definition: existing symmetric band IoU and BF1 at 1/2/3 px; not silently replaced

count_evidence: Author-reported E0 completion; prepare_e1a must verify actual frozen audit and manifests
scope: Original model/loss and frozen split. Six new runs only. Do not repeat seed1337 or regenerate development split.
